pathAssistantSteps.info: Re-issue application cancelled at applicant request.
New booklet dispatched. Cancelled old booklet is returned with it where policy requires.
Verify old passport, address proof and any Change of Details annexure (Annexure E / marriage certificate).
Re-issue draft. Capture Previous Passport No, Previous Passport Expiry and Reason For Re-issue before submitting.
Grant the re-issue. Old booklet must be cancelled and its Passport record marked Reissued.
Fee received. Move to document verification.
Awaiting re-issue fee. Fee depends on booklet pages and validity, not on Tatkal surcharge.
Re-issue defaults to Post-PV. Refer to the police station only if the address changed.
New booklet queued for printing. Link the old passport as Previous Passport.
Re-issue rejected. Record the reason on an Objection.
Submitted. Confirm the old booklet is surrendered at the counter and the re-issue reason matches the supporting document.
